<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/v1/containers/{id}/start"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Starts a container that exited (or was stopped) again with the settings it was created
with, until it is removed. `--rm` containers leave nothing to start. If the image layers
were pruned since, the current image for the same reference is used.
